SELECT bookmark_id, user_id, property_id, created_at FROM bookmark WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bookmark (user_id, property_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{propertyId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bookmark WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND property_id = #{propertyId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.property_id AS propertyId, pi.image_url AS thumbnailUrl, p.property_type AS propertyType, p.transaction_type AS transactionType, p.price AS price, p.deposit AS deposit, p.monthly_rent AS monthlyRent, p.area_m2 AS areaM2, p.floor AS floor, p.maintenance_fee AS maintenanceFee, CONCAT(r.province, ' ', r.city, ' ', r.district) AS regionName FROM bookmark b JOIN property p ON b.property_id = p.property_id LEFT JOIN region r ON p.region_id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN property_image pi ON p.property_id = pi.property_id AND pi.is_thumbnail = 1 AND pi.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
